caseName: Tide Water Associated Oil Co. v. Robison ex rel. Local 445, Oil Workers International Union
caseNameFull: Tide Water Associated Oil Co. v. Robison, on behalf of Local 445, Oil Workers International Union
attorneys: Marion B. Plant for appellant., Lindsay P. Walden for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed. Day-Brite Lighting, Inc. v. Missouri, 342 U. S. 421.

Mr. Justice Frankfurter and Mr. Justice Jackson are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted and the case set down for argument.
